The '''Daystar Casino''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] on [[Ahakista/Legends|Ahakista]], owned by [[Sardoth]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The years leading up to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] brought the casino great profits; however, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] presence on the planet drove away patrons. Sardoth had no option but to accept criminal assistance from [[Raze (criminal)|Raze]].
